in_marathi.name: Yajnesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Yajna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yajnesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words 'Yajna' meaning sacrifice and 'Ish' meaning Lord, Yajnesh symbolizes one who is the lord of the yajna or the ultimate sacrifice.
